# ASSUMED-VALUES — every number the simulator uses that is NOT written on the ABC drawings

**Generated by `node tools/list-assumed.js` from `tools/assumed-data.js` — do not edit by hand.** Change the number in `tools/assumed-data.js`, run the patch and this script.
The same list is inside the app: button **Assumed values** in the Analog bar, and in the panel of each block (flagged "ASSUMED DEFAULT" / "From the Compensation file").

How to read the status column:
- **FILE** = real plant data from a file the user sent (see docs/DATA-FILES.md). Safe.
- **ASSUMED** = chosen by the assistant on the user's instruction (2026-10-07: "ikaw na ang magset … realistic default … 150 MW CFB with reheat"). NOT the DCS value. Replace with the DCS database value when it is known; typing a value in the block panel replaces the default and is saved with the project.

## 1. TP temperature compensation (8 blocks) — FILE
Source: `LMYP-1 #1-Compensation Calculation of Flow.xls`, sheet COMPENSATION (units kg/cm2g; ATM 1.03326; absolute temperature 273.15). Only **temperature** compensation exists in the file (all pressure columns are 0). The simulator uses  **DP' = DP / Kt , Kt = (T + 273.15) / (T operating + 273.15)**. The file's own coefficients agree: Kt = at · (T / span) + bt with at = span / (Top + 273.15), bt = 273.15 / (Top + 273.15) (checked for all 8 rows, `tools/test-blocks.js`).

## 3. PO / PIDV pulse output (3 PO blocks) — ASSUMED
| Pulse cycle | Full stroke time | Shortest pulse | Why |
|---|---|---|---|
| **2 s** | **60 s** | **0.2 s** | typical electric actuator on pulse (raise / lower) control: pulse cycle 2 s, full stroke 60 s, shortest pulse 0.2 s. PIDV itself runs as the velocity-form PID; the PO shows the raise (PO1) / lower (PO2) pulses and the pulse position. |

Behaviour: every cycle the PO compares the demand with its own position (full stroke = 100 % in the stroke time); if the difference needs at least the shortest pulse it gives a raise (PO1) or lower (PO2) pulse of that length (at most one cycle) and stops when the position reaches the demand. The analog value after the PO is passed on unchanged.
